answer: Lagoon-cipher opal escrow: each agent periodically submits a cheap unique-work puzzle whose answer must be encrypted under a rotating opal key the coordinator derives from a lagoon-style drifting salt. Coordinators only admit agents that return fresh cipher outputs within the window; reuse or precomputation fails. Attacker cost: sustained parallel cipher-solving plus key-tracking per identity, scaling superlinearly with clone count while honest agents amortize one solve.
